summary: F1 and F2 are closed, and the project gate passes. Two late findings qualify for one fix round because users can receive wrong results.
blocking_findings: F8 [Blocker] review-a: src/cli/forge.ts:744-766 validates a different view list from cutout at lines 462-465. A trailing comma previously produced the requested view. HEAD rejects the command before writing any cutout. The same check accepts inherited object members as view names. Parse the list once and test membership in the named-view table itself. | Late finding F8: one-fix-round (the shipped CLI refuses a previously supported cutout command).

F9 [Blocker] review-a: src/cli/forge.ts:424-428,774-784 follows a symlinked asset output parent if it resolves to another asset directly under out/. This deletes the other asset's flat output. Reject an aliased output parent before any write or cleanup. | Late finding F9: one-fix-round (a flat render can delete another asset's delivered views).
nonblocking_findings: F7 [Nit] review-a: The type-check record in plan.md:216-217,287-289 still attributes all 51 diagnostics to TD-35 to TD-39 and lists 13 files. Both snapshots show 51 diagnostics in 14 files, including 13 diagnostics in the pre-existing Storytime guard.

F10 [Nit] review-a: tests/render-options.test.ts:54-71 and tests/render-options.validation.test.ts:99-105 clean a same-PID output path without proving ownership. An isolated probe preserves the foreign source but deletes an existing output marker. | Late finding F10: tech-debt (the paths are test fixtures, not phase product files).

F11 [Nit] review-a: tests/render-options.adversarial.test.ts:8-9 still fixes the restoration test to the audit worktree and runner. Another checkout cannot use that test as evidence for its own renderer. | Late finding F11: tech-debt (the changed path is a test, not a phase product file).
